arguments.query: select b.*, (select group_concat(charge_id||":"||coalesce(idempotency_key,"")) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b

select "C" t, charge_id a, booking_id b, idempotency_key c, status d, amount_cents e from charges union all select "H", booking_id, flight_id, passenger_id, null, null from holds union all select "O", event_id, booking_id, status, attempts, null from outbox
select name, sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","holds","outbox")
select "C" t, charge_id a, booking_id b, idempotency_key c, state d, amount_cents e from charges union all select "H", booking_id, flight_id, passenger_id, null, null from holds
select path,status,duration_ms,message from request_logs where status>=500 order by rowid desc limit 12
select b.booking_id,b.status,c.state,c.idempotency_key from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed" or c.state!="captured" or c.state is null
select rowid,path,status,message from request_logs where status not in (200) order by rowid desc limit 14

select (select count(*) from bookings) b,(select count(*) from checkins) ck,(select count(*) from outbox where status="delivered") od,(select group_concat(distinct kind) from customer_events) k,(select count(*) from customer_events) ce,(select count(*) from refunds) r, (select count(*) from fare_holds) fh
select sql from sqlite_master where name="customer_events"

select e.request_id, b.booking_id, b.status from customer_events e left join bookings b on b.request_id=e.request_id union all select "nocheckin", b.booking_id, b.status from bookings b where b.booking_id not in (select booking_id from checkins)
